observation: Fresh main now fails closed on malformed package.json and malformed npm workspace discovery output, but a syntactically valid package.json whose scripts field had the wrong top-level shape was still treated like a script-free package. In a mixed-language repository that could silently omit JavaScript validation while another validator still runs.
changes: Reject a present package.json scripts field unless it is a non-array object before any validation commands are inferred.
Reuse the existing VALIDATION_DISCOVERY_FAILED acceptance boundary with blocker INVALID_PACKAGE_SCRIPTS.
Keep omitted scripts valid so script-free packages and other language validators retain existing behavior.

verification.pre_fix_source_contract_replay: EXPECTED FAIL: packageValidationCommands used pkg?.scripts||{} and therefore collapsed strings, arrays, and null-like invalid script containers into no recognized validation scripts.
verification.post_fix_source_contract_replay: PASS: a present non-object/array/null scripts value fails before pyproject or other automatic validators can mask the malformed JavaScript manifest shape.
verification.focused_regression_contract: tests/acceptance-package-scripts-shape-integrity.test.mjs covers invalid scripts shape rejection and omitted-scripts compatibility.
verification.hosted_runtime: Developer Execution Runtime remained temporarily unavailable with HTTP 502; no hosted full-suite pass is claimed.

truth_boundary: This cycle validates only the existing package scripts container shape used by automatic discovery. It does not define new validation script names, package-manager policy, or workspace architecture.
